newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Alliance announces S$22 mln JV resort.
newsitem.headline: Alliance announces S$22 mln JV resort.

text.p: Alliance Technology and Development Ltd (ATD) said on Monday it was investing Singapore $22 million through a subsidiary in a joint venture company to develop a new leisure resort in Singapore.
ATD said in a statement its unit Fort Canning Country Club Investment Ltd (FCCC) had struck the joint venture with North Shore Marine Pte Ltd (NSM) to create Ubin Lagoon Resort Pte Ltd.
The joint venture will own and develop a site on Pulau Ubin, which ATD had earlier tendered successfully for from Singapore's Urban Development Authority.
The statement said the S$22 million investment would be made up of a combination of internal funds, bank borrowings and shareholders' loans.
FCCC would hold a controlling 51 percent stake in the joint venture, with NSM holding the balance.
ATD said the joint venture would compliment its existing hospitality businesses.
